claims.assertion: Format-aware syntactic content routing (ContentRouter) achieves 50-90% token reduction without semantic degradation, whereas blind uniform summarization destroys tabular structure and syntax boundaries.

Cross-Context Retrieval (CCR) deduplication replaces multi-turn repeated tool observations with deterministic SHA-256 digest markers ([CCR tool digest: <hash>]), stopping redundant observation bloat across multi-turn reasoning loops.

The prompt cache hot zone (system prompt) must NEVER be mutated in place; dynamic UUIDs/timestamps must be surfaced via detector-only checks rather than dynamic in-place rewriting to prevent prompt cache prefix busts (PR-A2 invariant).

On Claude 4.6+ models, prior-turn extended thinking reasoning blocks are billed as input tokens; converting them deterministically into compressed text markers stops compounding billing costs without affecting active reasoning.
